summary.text: Yes. You will receive the full $2,000 matching grant if you are eligible for the year and received at least $2,000 in cash top-ups.

details.heading: When you receive $2,000
details.body: You will receive the full matching grant if you are eligible for the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme for the year and the total cash top-ups you received was at least $2,000.

example_phrasings: Will I still get the full $2,000 if my savings go above the Basic Retirement Sum after topping up?
Do I get the full matching grant when my retirement savings exceed the Basic Retirement Sum?
Will exceeding the current Basic Retirement Sum affect my $2,000 matching grant?

sources.page_title: Will I still receive the full matching grant of $2,000 if my retirement savings exceed the current Basic Retirement Sum after topping up?

quotes.text: Yes, you will receive the full matching grant of $2,000 as long as you are eligible for the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme for the year, and the total amount of cash top-ups you received was at least $2,000.
